text:
oncall_bot: Paging maria_ops: high error rate detected on /v1/generate (5xx spike > 8% over 2m) :rotating_light:

maria_ops: ACK, joining. investigating now — looking at frontdoor and model routing.

sam_eng: I see increased 502s from the inference pool in eu-west-1. digging into GPU health and the router logs.

maria_ops: quick mitigation: switching traffic to fallback model variant (gen-v1-small) for critical customers, will post update once done.

jamie_cs: flagging customers on Dedicated who might see degraded throughput — cc @ops_manager for customer comms.

ops_manager: thanks — can we draft an initial status blurb for the status page and a short customer email? aim for concise and accurate, no speculation.

maria_ops: Draft initial statuspage copy below, please quick review: 
```
We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation in EU (eu-west-1). Traffic has been temporarily routed to a fallback model variant to reduce customer impact. Engineers are actively diagnosing the root cause.
- Impact: Some requests may see errors or reduced throughput.
- Scope: Primarily eu-west-1; hosted API & Dedicated customers in region may be affected.
- Next update: in 15 minutes or sooner.
```

sam_eng: +1 but add: "No data breach or customer data loss suspected." and a link to the oncall runbook: <https://internal/runbooks/ops-llm-502>.

jamie_cs: For customer email subject suggestion: "Service disruption affecting generation in EU — investigating". Body should include recommended mitigation: retry after 30s or switch to global endpoints.

ops_manager: edit accepted. final status text: 
```
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting generation in EU (eu-west-1). Traffic has been routed to a fallback model variant to reduce impact. Engineers are diagnosing root cause. No data breach or customer data loss suspected.
- Impact: Increased errors and reduced throughput for requests routed to eu-west-1.
- Scope: Hosted API and Dedicated customers in EU.
- Customer action: Retry requests after 30s or use global endpoints where possible.
- Next update: 15 minutes.
```

maria_ops: publishing now to statuspage (will ping here once live). :writing_hand:

statusbot: Status page update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1725000000 — initial update.

maria_ops: periodic update — we have reduced error rate to ~1.2% after fallback. continuing root cause analysis; collecting kernel logs from the affected instances. Next update in 20m.

sam_eng: found noisy GPU driver process on 2 hosts; restarting inference worker on those machines now. rolling restart across pool to avoid thundering herd.

jamie_cs: drafting customer note for Dedicated customers with suggested remediation steps and temporary credits offer. will share copy in 10m.

maria_ops: 30m update/resolved draft: 
```
Resolved: the elevated 5xx error rate in EU (eu-west-1) has been mitigated. Root cause: GPU driver instability on a subset of inference hosts causing intermittent worker failures. Affected hosts were restarted and traffic restored to primary model variants.
- Impact: Temporary errors and reduced throughput for some requests during the incident window.
- Scope: Hosted API and Dedicated customers in eu-west-1.
- Customer action: No action required. If you saw errors, retries should succeed now.
- Follow-up: We are implementing additional health probes and a safer rolling restart procedure; postmortem to follow.
```

ops_manager: approved. maria_ops — please publish resolved notice and send customer-facing email for Dedicated accounts with the approved wording.

maria_ops: Published resolved update and queued customer emails. Closing thread after postmortem draft is linked. :white_check_mark:

statusbot: Status page updated to "resolved" for incident 1725000000. Postmortem link pending.
